name: neuroai-workbench
description: Offline-first Python reference workbench for controlled NeuroAI assessment and observatory records
notes: Commands use the active Python environment and work on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Use synthetic or explicitly public fixtures only.
Do not expose local workspaces or credentials to background agents.
The default application performs no external model call or analytics request.
Model suggestions are untrusted drafts until a human disposition record exists.
